notes.title: 🚨 Welcome to Spearhead 2
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, tank commanders![/p][p]We’re thrilled to officially welcome you to the [b]Steam page for [i]Spearhead 2[/i][/b] – and to announce that [b]MicroProse[/b] is partnering on this exciting new chapter in tactical, armor-focused warfare.[/p][p]🎥 [b]Check out the brand-new trailer here[/b] and get a first look at what’s rolling your way:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OXqmQkVTIVE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]🔥 What is Spearhead 2?[/b][/h2][p][i]Spearhead 2[/i] is a modern, high-action armored warfare game built for both solo and co-op play. Take control of detailed, fully operational vehicles—tanks, IFVs, APCs—and engage in mission-based combat across war-torn cities and desert frontlines.[/p][p]Whether you're breaking through defenses or holding your ground under fire, [i]Spearhead 2[/i] puts you in the commander’s seat with an emphasis on realism, teamwork, and tactical pressure.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656557/9e8ac00431ba16e2b06db34c50bc70c3ee4655e8.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]👀 What’s Ahead?[/b][/h2][p]We’ll have more to share about [i]Spearhead 2[/i] in the coming months, including deeper looks at features, gameplay, and development progress. While we’re not ready to go into detail just yet, we’re excited about what’s taking shape behind the scenes—and we’ll be keeping you posted right here on Steam.[/p][p]💥 And as a bonus for fans of the original: [b]Spearhead 1[/b] is also planned to arrive on Steam in the near future![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656557/bb2657a5f2cecdea1b9a72311d94e2478f2b1109.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🫡 Join the Mission[/b][/h2][p]This is just the beginning of the journey. If [i]Spearhead 2[/i] looks like your kind of battlefield:[/p][p]✅ Add it to your [b]Steam Wishlist
[/b] 📢 Share the trailer with your crew
 👀 Follow the page to stay in the loop[/p][p]We’re proud to be working with the team behind [i]Spearhead 2[/i] and excited to bring this project to life with the support of the MicroProse community. Thanks for being here—we can’t wait to show you more as development continues.[/p][p]See you on the battlefield,
 — [b]The MicroProse Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656557/9d87551f96f07cab3f7bdbbf7ee59c4547b852bc.jpg"][/img][/p]
